day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Two things Saturday. Pick the one you actually want, tell them today.

signs.message: Free entry today. Go alone, stay an hour, no research.

signs.message: That window's been shut since August. Open it, stay in.
